observed.presence: durable agent/operation-runtime peer with generation and heartbeat
observed.stale_generation: stale peer self-stops without changing the current generation stop request
observed.restart_state: waiting/reconciliation state remains durable across coordinator restart
observed.idle: bounded two-cycle fake-provider serve completed without a Provider network request
observed.health: bounded peer and task-count projection excludes raw task payloads and credentials

limitations: This verifies a local foreground process boundary, not OS startup or Task Scheduler registration.
AR1 live recovery and Phase 8 single-root live activation remain separate roadmap work.
